notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1955 volume. Curated: construction contracts for the last 1947 bond buildings (North Beach, Upper Noe, the Recreational Arts Building in Duboce Park), Kezar Stadium's press box, the Conservatory's stove house, the Hall of Flowers architects and the Mount Davidson plaque.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (payments, leases, Camp Mather, Fleishhacker Pool, the yacht harbor, painting and roofing contracts) not curated; Stern Grove and Phelan Beach improvements and the Sutro Heights irrigation left out as minor or without a page.

findings.address_as_written: Construction of Press and Broadcasting Stand Alterations and Addition, Kezar Stadium
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to rebuild and enlarge the press and broadcasting stand at Kezar Stadium, designed by the consulting engineer Thomas F. Chace, to Robert L. Wilson at $93,000, the lowest of five bids.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, January 13, 1955, Resolution No. 1766

findings.address_as_written: Bronze plaque at Mt. Davidson honoring Mrs. Madie D. Brown
findings.description: At the Landmarks Council's request the Recreation and Park Commission approved replacing the bronze plaque on Mount Davidson honoring Madie D. Brown, whose efforts had made the summit a city park; the original plaque, put up in 1929, had been vandalized and taken.
